notes: Selected sample of 15 official job descriptions read on 17 Oct 2026 (UTC) for CV-variant decisions. Not statistically representative. Classification: mandatory = framed as required/need/must or an eligibility condition; preferred = framed as desirable/bonus/nice-to-have/not essential/ideally; unclear = listed without stated strictness. Paraphrases are short; quoted fragments are verbatim. posting_key links to data/verifications.json where a description hash was recorded.
